style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something huge crosses or fills the frame: the spit, a tag, the bucket, the goat's muzzle or the bell. Lens fully covered six times
character: a fluffy alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, mild and puzzled; copper bell on her neck; ears bare until 0.6
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, huge horns, square yellow pupils, chewing non-stop, muzzle at the lens filling half the screen. HIS EARS ARE BARE — he ate every tag he caught
props: TAGS all different: ORANGE round, size of her head; LIME small square; BLUE long narrow; a spray of TINY WHITE; RED round, twice the orange. Pictograms only, no letters. BUCKET: red plastic on the grass. BELL: copper, on her neck
prop_continuity: orange on her left ear from 0.6; lime in the goat's lip from 2.5; blue from the bucket at 3.5, taken by the goat at 5.5; white on her fringe; red on her right ear from 7.9
environment: a sunlit mountain pasture, green grass, blue sky, snowy peaks; the bucket on the ground
lighting: blazing mountain noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: mild puzzled female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: lines run together with no breath inside each sentence; one full stop only, 6.7-7.2; voiceless after 8.6, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a wet splat at 0.0, a plastic clack on every tag, the bell at 4.1 and 6.7, a hollow thud in the bucket at 8.6

timeline.a: silent. She throws her head forward and plasters the lens with a white glob: two frames solid white, then it runs down. Ears bare
the orange tag flies into the lens, blacks out the frame and is on her left ear; she strides at the lens until her head fills the frame
the GOAT's muzzle barges in from the right, half the screen, and snaps his jaw shut on the flying lime tag
silent. He kicks the bucket: it rolls into the lens, fills the frame, trundles off, and the blue tag falls out of it
she shakes her whole body like a wet dog, the tags and the long blue one sweeping twice across the full width of the frame
macro: one eye fills half the screen, the goat's lip pulls the blue tag off her while tiny white tags rain over the top of the frame
silent, the only stop. Both freeze and stare into the lens. Only the bell moves, swinging edge to edge
she rears up, the whole coloured mass lifting with her, and the red star tag flies into the lens and lands on her right ear
silent. Her head drops under the weight and the white glob flies into the bucket in close-up, a hollow thud
silent. The goat takes the whole cluster in his teeth and yanks; both heads come together at the lens
silent. The bell tears off, flies into the lens, fills the frame and rises away — she is lying in the grass, dust going up

must_appear: two animals in frame together, muzzles touching; a tag in the goat's mouth; her spit on the lens and later in the bucket; dust from the fall; the goat's ears BARE all clip
negative_prompt: tags or a collar on the goat's ears, letters, numbers, cyrillic, logos, readable text, subtitles, watermark, strings joining the tags, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, floating props, a second alpaca, slow motion, speed ramp, smooth dolly or orbit, the alpaca standing still in a wide shot, any voice from her after 8.6, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, grain, fog
camera_moves: wide, macro of her eye at 5.5, wide again at 9.6
